title: lophanthus allotrius
intro: Lophanthus allotrius, commonly known as Lophanthus, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, coughs, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lophanthus are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal agent. The bioactive constituents of Lophanthus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
